fields.quoted_span:
A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.
fields.note: The $50 cap, CPI adjustment only when the change is above zero, the penalty tiers, enforcement, remittance of the amount wrongfully charged, and rulemaking are all in the text. One small point: the State Treasurer determines the adjustment amount and the Director publishes the limit.

fields.quoted_span:
up to $500 for a
first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each
subsequent offense
fields.note: The $50 cap and penalty tiers are stated. The first CPI adjustment on January 1, 2027 follows from 'January 1 of the year next following enactment' and approval on January 20, 2026.

fields.quoted_span:
This act shall take effect on the first day of the
fourth month next following the date of enactment
fields.note: Approved January 20, 2026, so the fourth month following is May, giving 2026-05-01.

fields.quoted_span:
This act shall take effect on the first day of the
fourth month next following the date of enactment
fields.note: The document supports an effective date of May 1, 2026. It does not state a current or query date, so 'in_force' depends on information outside the document.

fields.quoted_span:
a dwelling unit
located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent; or
fields.note: The exclusions for one- and two-family dwellings and for Real Estate Commission licensees (unless the licensee is the landlord) are stated. min_units 3 is a reasonable reading of the one/two-family exclusion rather than a literal statement.
The document also shows C.46:8-18.1 and C.46:8-18.2. The N.J.S.A. forms are the standard equivalents.
